UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Private Admin and Spectator profile stored per authenticated Google user.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID matching the document ID.

displayName.description: Display name shown on live match broadcasts.

clubName.description: Optional cricket club or academy name.

updatedAt.description: Last update timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

LiveMatch.title: LiveMatch
LiveMatch.description: Low-latency denormalized live cricket scoreboard synced ball-by-ball by the match admin and observed in real time by spectators via shareCode.

adminId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the match admin scorer.

localMatchId.description: Local Room match ID on the admin device.

matchStatus.description: Current lifecycle status of the live broadcast.

sharingEnabled.description: Whether spectators with the shareCode can view live updates.

rrr.description: Required run rate formatted like 9.20 or empty in 1st innings.

targetRuns.description: Target runs in 2nd innings, or 0 in 1st innings.

chaseSummary.description: Live chase or match banner text.

lastBallBadge.description: Badge text for latest delivery (0, 1, 4, 6, W, WD).

lastShotZone.description: Fielding zone of the latest scored shot.

currentOverBalls.description: Labels for deliveries in the current over.

battingCardLines.description: Compact batting scorecard lines for current innings.

bowlingCardLines.description: Compact bowling scorecard lines for current innings.

potmSummary.description: Player of the Match summary once completed.

innings1BattingLines.description: Full batting scorecard lines for 1st innings.

innings1BowlingLines.description: Full bowling scorecard lines for 1st innings.

innings1FowLines.description: Fall of wickets chips for 1st innings.

innings2BattingLines.description: Full batting scorecard lines for 2nd innings.

innings2BowlingLines.description: Full bowling scorecard lines for 2nd innings.

innings2FowLines.description: Fall of wickets chips for 2nd innings.

hostTeamPhoto.description: Compact JPEG Base64 team avatar for the host team.

visitorTeamPhoto.description: Compact JPEG Base64 team avatar for the visitor team.

ballSequence.description: Monotonically increasing sequence counter for instant spectator animation.

updatedAt.description: Latest ball update timestamp via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

AvatarProfile.title: AvatarProfile
AvatarProfile.description: Compressed JPEG Base64 profile photo for a team or player owned by an Admin, stored directly in Firestore without external storage.

ownerUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owning admin.

entityType.description: Whether this photo belongs to a team or player.

entityName.description: Display name of the team or player.

teamName.description: Team name associated with the player (empty for TEAM).

photoBase64.description: Compressed square JPEG image encoded as compact Base64 (<= 32000 chars).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last photo update.

SavedTeam.title: SavedTeam
SavedTeam.description: Admin-saved cricket team with name, short code, optional photo, and squad player entries persisted per authenticated admin.

ownerUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owning admin.

photoBase64.description: Compressed team logo/photo encoded as Base64.

playerEntries.description: Saved squad player entries formatted as name|role.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of latest team update.

PlayerCareer.title: PlayerCareer
PlayerCareer.description: Synced player career record scoped under a live match so spectators can tap any player name to view their complete career profile.

adminId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owning match admin.

role.description: Playing role (e.g. Batsman, Bowler, All-Rounder, Wicket-Keeper).

photoBase64.description: Compressed square JPEG Base64 player avatar.

careerShotLines.description: Encoded career Wagon Wheel shot lines.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of latest career sync.

AdminRecord.title: AdminRecord
AdminRecord.description: Server-managed super-admin membership marker (no client writes).

enabled.description: Whether the UID is a super-admin.

/users/{userId}.description: Private profile document per authenticated Cricscore user.

/users/{userId}/avatars/{avatarId}.description: Compressed team and player profile photos owned by the admin.

/users/{userId}/saved_teams/{teamId}.description: Admin-saved teams with name, photo, and squad player lists.

/live_matches/{shareCode}.description: Real-time shared live scoreboard documents keyed by shareCode.

/live_matches/{shareCode}/player_careers.description: Player career profiles synced per live broadcast for instant spectator lookup.

/admins/{adminUid}.description: Server-managed admin registry checked by security rules.
